items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: And Richard Brooks wrote copy, he became a big producer of films in California. Writer, producer.

ctx.x: Because he became a singer also.

Oh everything. He was great. Just what Glenn wanted. Because he was trying to do that. See with my talking these things, I wasn’t singing, I was talking these novelty things. A la Ray McKinley, that kind of thing is what Glenn had in his mind. Personality, western, country, you know, get that style into the band. So I was very happy with Red. And I was certainly happy. First of all I was making 85 bucks a week and playing in New York and not traveling was just wonderful. Playing at the Commodore Hotel. Come in…
